McClaren managed Boro in the 2006 UEFA Cup final vs Sevilla in Eindhoven. He was named England manager on 4 May 2006, six days before the 10 May final, and it was his last match in charge — matches the hint exactly. Robson, Southgate and Strachan did all manage Middlesbrough, just in other seasons.

Ravanelli scored for Juventus in the 1996 Champions League final win over Ajax, then joined Middlesbrough for a club-record ~£7m six weeks later that summer, scoring a hat-trick on his league debut (3-3 vs Liverpool). Matches stem and hint.
Confirmed: Middlesbrough beat 10-man Man City 8-1 at the Riverside on the final day of 2007-08, with Afonso Alves (club-record ~£12.5m January 2008 signing from Heerenveen) scoring a hat-trick.
Confirmed: Boro's 2-1 win over Luton Town on 30 April 1995 was the last competitive match at Ayresome Park and sealed the Division One title; John Hendrie scored both goals.
Confirmed: Boksic joined Middlesbrough from Lazio in August 2000 aged 30, scoring 13 league goals in his first season, matching the hint.

Confirmed: Stewart Downing, a Boro academy graduate, left for Aston Villa on 16 July 2009 for an initial ~£10m fee after Boro's relegation; he later played for Liverpool and West Ham, and returned to Middlesbrough in 2015 for ~£5.5m, exactly as the hint states.
Confirmed: Juninho left Middlesbrough for Atlético Madrid in summer 1997 (after relegation) for a fee commonly cited around £12m, and returned to Teesside on loan in 1999-2000, matching the hint.
